content:
maya_cs: Heads up — Crescent AI QBR prep: seeing a 3x jump in embedding spend since onboarding, looks urgent. Can we triage?
ethan_csm: Saw it too in the dashboard this morning. Spike started ~Mar 18. Looks like embedding units mostly. @priya_finops can you pull a token/embedding breakdown?
priya_finops: Pulling now, will attach a short sample. Quick peek shows repeated nightly full reruns from their sync.
priya_finops: sample rows:
```
user: crescent-42, model: text-embedding-3-small, embedding_units: 12k/day -> 36k/day
user: sync_job: nightly-full, runs: 1x @ 02:00 UTC, started 2026-03-18
```
priya_finops: Main culprit: their nightly full reindex + a handful of large batch reruns.
nora_engineer: That nightly job is their import pipeline (we flagged incremental as a suggestion during onboarding). They implemented full reindex as a workaround; I asked them to switch but haven't heard back.
maya_cs: Proposed immediate actions: 1) ask customer to pause nightly reindex, 2) enable temporary account-level embedding throttle, 3) prepare commit/retainer options or a Dedicated pool recommendation. Who owns each?
ethan_csm: I'll own the customer convo + pause request, pinging them now.
priya_finops: I'll run 3 cost sims (no commit, 3mo commit, 12mo commit) and model projected savings. Need 30-day avg; @billing-bot can you attach last 30d CSV?
billing-bot: cost CSV uploaded: https://redwood.prod/storage/csvs/1747352468-crescent-costs.csv :receipt:
maya_cs: Also important for the QBR: capture that the full reindex was a workaround for missing incremental tooling. Add to "onboarding friction" notes and feedback capture.
ethan_csm: Scheduling QBR for 2026-03-28 11:00 PT. Added priya/nora to the invite.
nora_engineer: I'll draft a short incremental reindex guide and example code snippet to share with their infra team.
nora_engineer: example pseudo-code:
```
# incremental reindex pattern
cursor = last_synced_id
while True:
  updates = fetch_updates(cursor, limit=500)
  if not updates: break
  embeddings = compute_embeddings(updates)
  upsert_embeddings(embeddings)
  cursor = updates[-1].id
```
maya_cs: Nice. Follow-ups: priya deliver commit sims by EOD Friday, nora send guide by tomorrow noon, ethan confirm pause with customer today. I'll update the QBR prep checklist and include the cost slides + feedback bullet points. :thumbsup: 
ethan_csm: On it, sending pause request now.
priya_finops: Will include pricing & savings table and a quick recommendation: short commit vs Dedicated depending on 30/90 day projected steady state.
maya_cs: Thanks team — logging this thread into the QBR folder and will surface the slides in the dry run tomorrow.
